    Removing redundant projective terms at a stable module #

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.minimalPresentation_stable {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) (p : MinimalPresentation (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential)) {B : FGModuleCat R} (hB : (eulerWeight k P).IsStable B) :
    p.twoTerm.IsPresilting ∧ (eulerWeight k p.twoTerm).IsStable B

    Passing to the minimal presentation of the cokernel preserves stability of every module stable at the original presilting weight. On quotients of such a module the Euler evaluations both count maps from the cokernel.
